🛠️ CLI Custom Theme Generator

Generate a fully documented custom brand theme file with every token preset and commented.

# Generate a starter custom theme via FlowX CLI:
$ npx flowx theme create my-brand
✔ Created custom theme template at: ./theme-my-brand.css
✔ Activate in HTML via <html data-theme="my-brand">

📖 Canonical Token Reference Table

Complete overview of all CSS custom properties defined on :root.

Token Name Description Light Default Dark Default
--flowx-bg-base Main page canvas background #f8fafc #0a0a0a
--flowx-bg-surface Card, panel, and container background #ffffff #171717
--flowx-bg-surface-raised Elevated elements (Modals, Dropdowns) #ffffff #262626
--flowx-bg-hover Interactive element hover background tint rgba(0,0,0,0.05) rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
--flowx-color-primary Primary brand accent color #2563eb #3b82f6
--flowx-color-secondary Secondary accent color #475569 #94a3b8
--flowx-color-text Primary body text color #0f172a #f8fafc
--flowx-color-text-muted Secondary / muted text color #64748b #94a3b8
--flowx-border-color Default border & divider color #e2e8f0 #262626
--flowx-shadow-color Shadow tint (Glowing in dark mode) rgba(0,0,0,0.08) rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
--flowx-space-1 .. 8 Spacing scale (4px to 40px) 4px to 40px 4px to 40px
--flowx-radius-sm .. lg Border radius scale (4px, 8px, 16px, 9999px) 4px to 9999px 4px to 9999px
